hard_gates.evidence: Plant L11 (plants/L11-file-local-static-sorted-search-total.patch, 13 lines in ListBinding.cs) is a C# file-local class (`file static class SortedSearchTotals`) holding a static ConcurrentDictionary<string,int>. A request with both an explicit sort and a search reuses the total first counted for list|search|filter|sort, whatever the tenant. All 53 G1 tests PASSED with it (plants/run-L11-g1-all.log, 32 min), including ProcessState, TenantSource, NonInterference, HttpIsolation/ListAnswers and WriteOracle. Live on a plant stack (plants/plant-live-L11.txt): gulfsteel's GET /api/identity/users?search=khalid&sort=displayName answers total 52, which is alnoor's count; gulfsteel has 28 rows and the same query without sort says 28. odoo.notes: Harness: run.mjs --task find-user --product both --repeat 3, branding hidden (compare/). Ours is judged on one whole path; Odoo gets its best path per metric. Every committed ours path loses, on keystrokes, to Odoo's critic path: 'shortest' 8, 'prefixes' 15, 'enter' 21, against 5. The margins are thin: 1 keystroke and 0.13 s of machine time. biggest_gap.title: Sorted list queries are judged by no gate, and file-local classes are invisible to process state, so a tenant-blind total memo in the list engine passes all of G1
biggest_gap.detail: Every later module registers its lists with p05 and relies on G1 to attack them automatically. The list contract has five query inputs: search, filter, sort, paging and grouping. ListAnswers, the only gate that judges what a total adds up to, sends search, filter and groupBy but never sort. Every header click in the client sends sort. HttpIsolation and ListContract send sort, but never with a search and never judging the total. NonInterference cannot see static state by design and leaves it to the process-state gate. That gate's IsGenerated skips any type whose name contains '<'. That includes every C# `file`-local class, which is an ordinary language feature, so the statics of such a class are neither inspected nor walked. Plant L11 combines the two: a `file static class` in ListBinding.cs keeps a ConcurrentDictionary of totals keyed by list|search|filter|sort with no tenant. Fixes: (a) in ListAnswers (and NonInterference's list requests), walk every query also with each sortable column in both directions, alone and combined with the searches and filters already used, and judge the total and groups of every page; (b) in ProcessState/ReachableState, treat as generated only types with [CompilerGenerated] or [GeneratedCode] whose names match closure, display-class or state-machine patterns, and inspect C# file-local types (<File>F…__Name) like any other type; (c) add a tenant-source or process-state rule for static mutable collections (ConcurrentDictionary, Dictionary and the like) in any product type.
biggest_gap.evidence: Apply gauntlet/evidence/p05-list-search/r7/plants/L11-file-local-static-sorted-search-total.patch and run `dotnet test tests/Erp.Gates.Tests -c Release --filter FullyQualifiedName~Erp.Gates.Tests.G1`: 53/53 pass (plants/run-L11-g1-all.log; ProcessState and TenantSource alone in plants/run-L11-structural.log). Live on a stack with the plant (scripts/live-probe.mjs <url> l11, plants/plant-live-L11.txt): after admin@alnoor asks GET /api/identity/users?take=50&search=khalid&sort=displayName (total 52), admin@gulfsteel gets total 52 for the same request, but only 28 rows; without sort it says 28. On screen, gulfsteel sorts Users by Name, types 'khalid' and sees '52 users' (plants/plant-L11-gulfsteel-sorted-search-shows-other-tenant-total.jpg).

C# file-local types (`file class X`, compiled as <File>F<hash>__X) are therefore skipped as roots and never judged, in every module, not only lists.

Scope checks in the browser at 1600x900 over 100,005 users (ui-en.txt, ui-sort.txt, ui-ar.txt): the list renders in 86 ms with 33 DOM rows, and the search has the focus on arrival. Search as you type gives 1,651 matches for 'm pi' in about 380 ms. 'maj ani pil' then Enter opens the record panel, and Esc returns to the grid. ArrowDown enters the grid; End reaches row 100,005 (the oldest user) and Home goes back. Space and Shift+Arrow select, and Ctrl+A twice selects all 100,005 that match, offering Copy, Deactivate and Activate. Headers are reachable by Tab and sort with Enter (asc, then desc). Column menus offer Filter…, Group by this column and Hide this column; the column chooser reorders columns. Arabic is RTL with Arabic chrome and CLDR plurals ('100,005 مستخدمين'), and the spelling-variant search 'ماجد انيل بيلاى' finds 'ماجد أنيل بيلاي'.

Performance over 100,005 users (perf.txt, median of 5 round trips): exact name 11 ms, 'maj ani pil' 9 ms, '068311' 7 ms, 'a' 40 ms, Arabic variant 36 ms, filter 16 ms, groupBy 33 ms, skip 50,000 25 ms, skip 99,950 sorted by name 66 ms. 'm pi' (1,651 ranked matches) took 176 ms median and 512 ms max, the slowest query and the one the winning find-user path uses.
